title: Muvengi Ane Moto
intro: Mumazuva ekutanga ekuzarurwa, mumwe munhu akabuda semuvengi akasindimara wechokwadi. Akomborerwa nepfuma nechinzvimbo, mweya uyu wakasarudza kuzvikudza pane kutungamirirwa, uye nyaya yavo yakava yambiro yakasimba mundima dzekupedzisira dzesurah.
clues: Ndaigara muguta rimwe chete neMuporofita, uye ndaiva pakati pehama dzake dzepedyo, asi kuzvikudza kwangu kwakandiita kuti ndisave nechokwadi.
Ndaiva nepfuma yakawanda uye pfuma yakawanda, uye ndaifunga kuti pfuma yangu yaizogara ichindidzivirira.
Shoko parakazoburitswa pachena, ndakariseka pachena ndikabva ndafuratira, ndichizviti ndiri mukuru kupfuura vatendi.
Ruvengo rwangu rwaive rwakakurumbira zvekuti surah yeKorani yakataura neni zvakananga, ichindidana nezita randaizivikanwa nevamwe.
Ndakanyeverwa kuti pfuma yangu nemari yangu zvaisazondibatsira, uye ndaizokandwa mumoto unopfuta.
Ndinozivikanwa sababa vemurazvo, uye mudzimai wangu anotakura huni netambo yeshinda yemuchindwe yakakomberedza mutsipa wake.
